title: The 5 equipments you NEED in your home gym
summary: NH lists the five pieces of equipment he considers necessary to build your body at home, ranked by importance, and says the first three alone are enough for excellent gains. The captions are garbled, but mentions of a pull-up bar and dip station combo, resistance bands and push-up work survive.
claims: Five pieces of equipment are necessary to build your body at home, and you can make excellent gains with the first three alone
A combined dip station and pull-up bar is one of the key home gym pieces
Resistance bands are recommended as a cheap home gym tool
exercises: core home back movement with a pull-up bar
core home pushing movement with a dip station
floor pushing work with minimal equipment
